messages:
Mei Chen: Quick check — SOC2 sprint gate this Wed. Who's owning the KMS runbook updates and the auditlog retention change? Need owners so we can sign off for fieldwork. /cc @Jordan @Alice
Jordan Patel: I can take runbook edits, but need infra confirmation on key rotation window. Ravi, can you confirm rotation schedule for staging keys?
Ravi Singh: Staging rotation currently set to 03:00 UTC weekly. Prod is monthly and needs change for SOC2. I'll check with infra team, should know by EOD. :thinking:
Alice Nguyen: I can own auditlog retention doc. Which retention period are we proposing? Ops asked for 90d vs compliance wanting 365d.
Mei Chen: Compliance wants 365d but product ops flagged cost. For fieldwork we can scope to sampling; still need documented decision. Can we add a fallback policy?
Priya Patel: Suggestion: add a conditional retention policy: 365d for security-critical logs, 90d for access logs. Drafted snippet below:
```text
- security_logs: 365d (immutable)
- access_logs: 90d (rolled)
- alerts: 1 year (aggregated)
```
Jordan Patel: Looks fine. For KMS, we also need key custody statement for HSM vs cloud KMS. Are we OK with customer-managed keys?
security-bot: Reminder: SOC2 control CC6 requires key custody defined. See RFC at https://go.redwood/rfc-kms
Mei Chen: Jordan — can you link the runbook PR when you open it? Alice — can you add the retention decision to the audit evidence doc?
Jordan Patel: I will open PR and tag @Ravi for infra review. Plan to have PR up by 2026-03-12 EOD.
Ravi Singh: Confirmed — infra review by 2026-03-13. Also flagging a dep: older logging agent version doesn't support immutability flag. Need eng-runtime to cut patch.
Mei Chen: Who from eng-runtime can take the agent patch? @Priya any contacts?
Priya Patel: I'll ping Sam from eng-runtime and loop back. Expect update by tomorrow morning. :white_check_mark:
Alice Nguyen: I'll queue the audit evidence with the retention decision and link the runbook PR when Jordan posts it.
Mei Chen: Great — owners: Jordan (KMS runbook), Alice (audit retention evidence), Ravi (infra/key rotation), Priya (runtime patch liaison). I'll update the sprint board and mark risk: logging agent. Thanks all.
Jordan Patel: PR opened: https://git.redwood/repo/pull/4321 — tagging reviewers @Ravi @Sam
Ravi Singh: Added review comments, noted agent dep. Will escalate if eng-runtime doesn't respond by EOD.
Priya Patel: Sam replied, assigned to Sam. Will update thread once patch lands.
security-bot: Fieldwork slot reserved 2026-03-18, 13:00 UTC. Confirmed evidence required 48h prior.
Mei Chen: Acknowledged. Let's aim to have all docs + PRs linked by 2026-03-16 COB.
Alice Nguyen: On it.
